title: Sparkly drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Drum body -->
  <rect x='30' y='40' width='40' height='35' rx='3' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- Body highlight (contrasting shade) -->
  <rect x='33' y='42' width='8' height='31' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- Drum rim top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='7' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- Drum head top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='17' ry='5.5' fill='#fdf2d0'/>
  <!-- Rim bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='20' ry='7' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- Rim bottom fill (front) -->
  <path d='M30 75 A20 7 0 0 0 70 75 L70 40 A20 7 0 0 1 30 40 Z' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Side lugs / tension rods -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='4' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <rect x='66' y='45' width='4' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <rect x='47' y='42' width='4' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#e8940e'/>
  <!-- Drum head shimmer lines -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='10' ry='3' fill='none' stroke='#f7e3a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top-left -->
  <path d='M18 20 L20 26 L26 28 L20 30 L18 36 L16 30 L10 28 L16 26 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top-right -->
  <path d='M80 15 L81.5 20 L87 21.5 L81.5 23 L80 28 L78.5 23 L73 21.5 L78.5 20 Z' fill='#fff176'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 left -->
  <path d='M12 55 L13.5 59 L18 60.5 L13.5 62 L12 66 L10.5 62 L6 60.5 L10.5 59 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 right -->
  <path d='M86 50 L87.5 54 L92 55.5 L87.5 57 L86 61 L84.5 57 L80 55.5 L84.5 54 Z' fill='#fff176'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 bottom-left small -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='2' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 bottom-right small -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='84' r='2.5' fill='#fff176'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 7 tiny top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 8 tiny bottom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='90' r='2' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 9 left mid -->
  <path d='M5 40 L6.5 43.5 L10 45 L6.5 46.5 L5 50 L3.5 46.5 L0 45 L3.5 43.5 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 10 right mid -->
  <path d='M95 35 L96.5 38.5 L100 40 L96.5 41.5 L95 45 L93.5 41.5 L90 40 L93.5 38.5 Z' fill='#fff176'/>
</svg>
